verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁ֣ב שָׁא֔וּל מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּגִּ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד בְּמִדְבַּ֖ר עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer šāḇ šā·’ūl mê·’a·ḥă·rê pə·liš·tîm way·yag·gi·ḏū lōw lê·mōr hin·nêh ḏā·wiḏ bə·miḏ·bar ‘ên ge·ḏî
verses.literal: After Saul had returned from pursuing the Philistines he was told - David is in the wilderness of En-gedi
verses.literalPt: Tendo Saul voltado de perseguir os filisteus, foi-lhe dito: Eis que Davi está no deserto de En-Gedi.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח שָׁא֗וּל שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ בָּח֖וּר מִכָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ לְבַקֵּ֤שׁ אֶת־ דָּוִד֙ וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֔יו עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י צוּרֵ֥י הַיְּעֵלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ šā·’ūl šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’îš bā·ḥūr mik·kāl yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·leḵ lə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ wa·’ă·nā·šāw ‘al- pə·nê ṣū·rê hay·yə·‘ê·lîm
verses.literal: So Saul took three thousand chosen men from all Israel and went to look for David and his men in the region of the Rocks of the Wild Goats
verses.literalPt: Tomando Saul três mil homens, escolhidos dentre todo o Israel, foi em busca de Davi e dos seus homens até sobre as penhas das cabras monteses.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹא אֶל־ גִּדְר֨וֹת הַצֹּ֤אן עַל־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ וְשָׁ֣ם מְעָרָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֥א שָׁא֖וּל לְהָסֵ֣ךְ אֶת־ רַגְלָ֑יו וְדָוִד֙ וַאֲנָשָׁ֔יו בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמְּעָרָ֖ה יֹשְׁבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’el- giḏ·rō·wṯ haṣ·ṣōn ‘al- had·de·reḵ wə·šām mə·‘ā·rāh way·yā·ḇō šā·’ūl lə·hā·sêḵ ’eṯ- raḡ·lāw wə·ḏā·wiḏ wa·’ă·nā·šāw bə·yar·kə·ṯê ham·mə·‘ā·rāh yō·šə·ḇîm
verses.literal: Soon Saul came to the sheepfolds . . . along the road where there was a cave and he went in to relieve himself And David and his men were hiding in the recesses of the cave
verses.literalPt: Chegou, no caminho, a uns currais de ovelhas, onde havia uma cova; entrou nela Saul a aliviar o ventre. Ora, Davi e seus homens estavam sentados na parte mais interna da cova.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י דָוִ֜ד אֵלָ֗יו הִנֵּ֨ה הַיּ֜וֹם אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י נֹתֵ֤ן אֶת־ אֹיְבֶיךָ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יִטַ֣ב בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וַיָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֗ד וַיִּכְרֹ֛ת אֶת־ כְּנַֽף־ הַמְּעִ֥יל אֲשֶׁר־ לְשָׁא֖וּל בַּלָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’an·šê ḏā·wiḏ ’ê·lāw hin·nêh hay·yō·wm ’ăšer- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ê·le·ḵā hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·ṯên ’eṯ- ʾō·yə·ḇɛ·ḵå̄ bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lōw ka·’ă·šer yi·ṭaḇ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā way·yā·qām dā·wiḏ way·yiḵ·rōṯ ’eṯ- kə·nap̄- ham·mə·‘îl ’ă·šer- lə·šā·’ūl bal·lāṭ
verses.literal: So David’s men said to him This is the day about which the LORD said to you Behold I will deliver your enemy into your hand that you may do with him as you wish . . . Then David crept up and stealthily cut off a corner of Saul’s robe
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe os homens de Davi: Este é o dia do qual te disse Jeová: Eis que te entrego nas mãos o teu inimigo, e far-lhe-ás o que bem te parecer. Davi levantou-se e, de mansinho, cortou a orla do manto de Saul.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן וַיַּ֥ךְ לֵב־ דָּוִ֖ד אֹת֑וֹ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֔ת אֶת־ כָּנָ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְשָׁאֽוּל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên way·yaḵ lêḇ- dā·wiḏ ’ō·ṯōw ‘al ’ă·šer kā·raṯ ’eṯ- kā·nāp̄ ’ă·šer lə·šā·’ūl
verses.literal: Afterward . . . David’s conscience was stricken because he had cut off the corner of Saul’s robe
verses.literalPt: Depois, bateu o coração de Davi, por ter cortado a orla do manto de Saul.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לַאֲנָשָׁ֜יו חָלִ֧ילָה לִּ֣י מֵֽיהוָ֗ה אִם־ אֶעֱשֶׂה֩ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֨ר הַזֶּ֤ה לַֽאדֹנִי֙ לִמְשִׁ֣יחַ יְהוָ֔ה לִשְׁלֹ֥חַ יָדִ֖י בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer la·’ă·nā·šāw ḥā·lî·lāh lî Yah·weh ’im- ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh la·ḏō·nî lim·šî·aḥ Yah·weh liš·lō·aḥ yā·ḏî bōw kî- mə·šî·aḥ Yah·weh hū
verses.literal: So he said to his men The LORD forbid that I should do such a thing to my master the LORD’s anointed May I never lift my hand against him since he is the LORD’s anointed
verses.literalPt: Disse aos seus homens: Deus me guarde de que eu faça isso ao meu senhor, ao ungido de Jeová, a saber, que eu estenda a mão contra ele, visto que ele é o ungido de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְשַׁסַּ֨ע דָּוִ֤ד אֶת־ אֲנָשָׁיו֙ בַּדְּבָרִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א נְתָנָ֖ם לָק֣וּם אֶל־ שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֛וּל קָ֥ם מֵהַמְּעָרָ֖ה וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·šas·sa‘ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- ’ă·nā·šāw bad·də·ḇā·rîm wə·lō nə·ṯā·nām lā·qūm ’el- šā·’ūl wə·šā·’ūl qām mê·ham·mə·‘ā·rāh way·yê·leḵ bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: With these words David restrained his men and he did not let them rise up against Saul Then Saul left the cave and went on his way
verses.literalPt: Com essas palavras, conteve Davi os seus homens e não lhes permitiu que se lançassem contra Saul. Saindo Saul da cova, prosseguiu o seu caminho.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֜ד אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן וַיֵּצֵא֙ מִן־ הַמְּעָרָה וַיִּקְרָ֧א אַֽחֲרֵי־ שָׁא֛וּל לֵאמֹ֖ר אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיַּבֵּ֤ט שָׁאוּל֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔יו וַיִּקֹּ֨ד דָּוִ֥ד אַפַּ֛יִם אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām dā·wiḏ ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên way·yê·ṣê min- ham·mə·ʿå̄·rå̄h way·yiq·rā ’a·ḥă·rê- šā·’ūl lê·mōr ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ way·yab·bêṭ šā·’ūl ’a·ḥă·rāw way·yiq·qōḏ dā·wiḏ ’ap·pa·yim ’ar·ṣāh way·yiš·tā·ḥū
verses.literal: After that David got up went out of the cave and called out to Saul . . . My lord the king When Saul looked behind him David bowed facedown . . . in reverence
verses.literalPt: Levantou-se também Davi depois dele e, tendo saído da cova, gritou a Saul, dizendo: Ó rei, meu senhor! Olhando Saul para trás, prostrou-se Davi com o rosto em terra e fez-lhe uma reverência.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ לְשָׁא֔וּל לָ֧מָּה תִשְׁמַ֛ע אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י אָדָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ lə·šā·’ūl lām·māh ṯiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- diḇ·rê ’ā·ḏām lê·mōr hin·nêh ḏā·wiḏ mə·ḇaq·qêš rā·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: and said to Saul Why do you listen to the words of men who say Look David intends to harm you
verses.literalPt: Disse Davi a Saul: Por que dás ouvidos às palavras dos que dizem: Davi procura fazer-te mal?

verses.original: הִנֵּה֩ הַיּ֨וֹם הַזֶּ֜ה רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ נְתָנְךָ֩ יְהוָ֨ה׀ הַיּ֤וֹם׀ בְּיָדִי֙ בַּמְּעָרָ֔ה וְאָמַ֥ר לַהֲרָגֲךָ֖ וַתָּ֣חָס עָלֶ֑יךָ וָאֹמַ֗ר לֹא־ אֶשְׁלַ֤ח יָדִי֙ בַּֽאדֹנִ֔י כִּי־ מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh hay·yō·wm haz·zeh rā·’ū ‘ê·ne·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer- nə·ṯā·nə·ḵā Yah·weh hay·yō·wm bə·yā·ḏî bam·mə·‘ā·rāh wə·’ā·mar la·hă·rā·ḡă·ḵā wat·tā·ḥās ‘ā·le·ḵā wā·’ō·mar lō- ’eš·laḥ yā·ḏî ba·ḏō·nî kî- mə·šî·aḥ Yah·weh hū
verses.literal: Behold this day you have seen with your own eyes that the LORD . . . delivered you into my hand in the cave I was told to kill you but I spared you and said I will not lift my hand against my lord since he is the LORD’s anointed
verses.literalPt: Eis que os teus próprios olhos viram hoje que Jeová te entregou nas minhas mãos quando estavas na cova, e foi-me dito que eu te matasse, porém a minha mão te poupou, e eu disse: Não estenderei a minha mão contra o meu senhor, porque é o ungido de Jeová.

verses.original: וְאָבִ֣י רְאֵ֔ה גַּ֗ם רְאֵ֛ה אֶת־ כְּנַ֥ף מְעִילְךָ֖ בְּיָדִ֑י כִּ֡י בְּכָרְתִי֩ אֶת־ כְּנַ֨ף מְעִֽילְךָ֜ וְלֹ֣א הֲרַגְתִּ֗יךָ דַּ֤ע וּרְאֵה֙ כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין בְּיָדִ֜י רָעָ֤ה וָפֶ֙שַׁע֙ וְלֹא־ חָטָ֣אתִי לָ֔ךְ וְאַתָּ֛ה צֹדֶ֥ה אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֖י לְקַחְתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḇî rə·’êh gam rə·’êh ’eṯ- kə·nap̄ mə·‘î·lə·ḵā bə·yā·ḏî kî bə·ḵā·rə·ṯî ’eṯ- kə·nap̄ mə·‘î·lə·ḵā wə·lō hă·raḡ·tî·ḵā da‘ ū·rə·’êh kî ’ên bə·yā·ḏî rā·‘āh wā·p̄e·ša‘ wə·lō- ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lāḵ wə·’at·tāh ṣō·ḏeh ’eṯ- nap̄·šî lə·qaḥ·tāh
verses.literal: See . . . my father look at the corner of your robe in my hand For I cut it . . . off but I did not kill you Know and see that there is no evil or rebellion in my hands I have not sinned against you even though you are hunting me down to take my life
verses.literalPt: Vê, meu pai, vê a orla do manto na minha mão. No fato de cortar eu a orla do manto sem te matar, reconhece que não há na minha mão nem mal nem transgressão e que não pequei contra ti, ainda que tu andes à caça da minha vida para ma tirares.

verses.original: יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט יְהוָה֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔ךָ וּנְקָמַ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑ךָּ וְיָדִ֖י לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶה־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·pōṭ Yah·weh bê·nî ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā ū·nə·qā·ma·nî Yah·weh mim·me·kā wə·yā·ḏî lō ṯih·yeh- bāḵ
verses.literal: May the LORD judge between you and me . . . and may the LORD take vengeance on you but my hand will never be against you
verses.literalPt: Jeová seja o juiz entre mim e ti e Jeová me vingue de ti; a minha mão, porém, não será contra ti.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאמַ֗ר מְשַׁל֙ הַקַּדְמֹנִ֔י מֵרְשָׁעִ֖ים יֵ֣צֵא רֶ֑שַׁע וְיָדִ֖י לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶה־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer yō·mar mə·šal haq·qaḏ·mō·nî mê·rə·šā·‘îm yê·ṣê re·ša‘ wə·yā·ḏî lō ṯih·yeh- bāḵ
verses.literal: As the old proverb says Wickedness proceeds from the wicked But my hand will never be against you
verses.literalPt: Como diz o provérbio dos antigos: Dos ímpios procede a impiedade. A minha mão, porém, não será contra ti.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֨י מִ֤י יָצָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַחֲרֵ֥י מִ֖י אַתָּ֣ה רֹדֵ֑ף אַֽחֲרֵי֙ כֶּ֣לֶב מֵ֔ת אַחֲרֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֥שׁ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê mî yā·ṣā me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ’a·ḥă·rê mî ’at·tāh rō·ḏêp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê ke·leḇ mêṯ ’a·ḥă·rê par·‘ōš ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Against whom has the king of Israel come out . . . Whom are you pursuing . . . A dead . . . dog A flea
verses.literalPt: Após quem saiu o rei de Israel? A quem persegues tu? Persegues a um cão morto, a uma pulga.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְדַיָּ֔ן וְשָׁפַ֖ט בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ וְיֵ֙רֶא֙ וְיָרֵ֣ב אֶת־ רִיבִ֔י וְיִשְׁפְּטֵ֖נִי מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh Yah·weh lə·ḏay·yān wə·šā·p̄aṭ bê·nî ū·ḇê·ne·ḵā wə·yê·re wə·yā·rêḇ ’eṯ- rî·ḇî wə·yiš·pə·ṭê·nî mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: May the LORD be our judge and decide between you and me . . . May He take notice and plead my case and deliver me from your hand
verses.literalPt: Seja Jeová juiz, e julgue entre mim e ti, e veja e pleiteie a minha causa, e me livre das tuas mãos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּכַלּ֣וֹת דָּוִ֗ד לְדַבֵּ֞ר אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל הֲקֹלְךָ֥ זֶ֖ה בְּנִ֣י דָוִ֑ד וַיִּשָּׂ֥א שָׁא֛וּל קֹל֖וֹ וַיֵּֽבְךְּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·wṯ dā·wiḏ lə·ḏab·bêr ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’el- šā·’ūl way·yō·mer šā·’ūl hă·qō·lə·ḵā zeh bə·nî ḏā·wiḏ way·yiś·śā šā·’ūl qō·lōw way·yê·ḇək
verses.literal: When David had finished saying these things - Saul called back Is that your voice David my son Then Saul wept aloud . . .
verses.literalPt: Tendo Davi acabado de falar a Saul estas palavras, perguntou Saul: É esta a tua voz, meu filho Davi? Então, Saul levantou a voz e chorou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד צַדִּ֥יק אַתָּ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ גְּמַלְתַּ֣נִי הַטּוֹבָ֔ה וַאֲנִ֖י גְּמַלְתִּ֥יךָ הָרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- dā·wiḏ ṣad·dîq ’at·tāh mim·men·nî kî ’at·tāh gə·mal·ta·nî haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh wa·’ă·nî gə·mal·tî·ḵā hā·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: and said to David You are more righteous than I for you have rewarded me with good though I have rewarded you with evil
verses.literalPt: Disse a Davi: Tu és mais justo do que eu, pois tu me tens feito o bem, e eu te tenho feito o mal.

verses.original: וְאַתְּ הִגַּ֣דְתָּ הַיּ֔וֹם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֥יתָה אִתִּ֖י טוֹבָ֑ה אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר סִגְּרַ֧נִי יְהוָ֛ה בְּיָדְךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א הֲרַגְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ʾat hig·gaḏ·tā hay·yō·wm ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯāh ’it·tî ṭō·w·ḇāh ’êṯ ’ă·šer sig·gə·ra·nî Yah·weh bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā wə·lō hă·raḡ·tā·nî
verses.literal: And you have declared this day how you have treated me well for when the LORD delivered me into your hand you did not kill me
verses.literalPt: Tu me mostraste hoje que grande bem me fizeste, pois, tendo-me Jeová entregado nas tuas mãos, não me tiraste a vida.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִמְצָ֥א אִישׁ֙ אֶת־ אֹ֣יְב֔וֹ וְשִׁלְּח֖וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבָ֑ה וַֽיהוָה֙ יְשַׁלֶּמְךָ֣ טוֹבָ֔ה תַּ֚חַת הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתָה לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yim·ṣā ’îš ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇōw wə·šil·lə·ḥōw bə·ḏe·reḵ ṭō·w·ḇāh Yah·weh yə·šal·lem·ḵā ṭō·w·ḇāh ta·ḥaṯ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯāh lî
verses.literal: When a man finds his enemy does he let him go away unharmed May the LORD reward you with good for what you have done for me this day
verses.literalPt: Por que quem há que, encontrando a seu inimigo, o deixará sem lhe fazer mal? Jeová te pague com o bem o que hoje me fizeste.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י מָלֹ֖ךְ תִּמְל֑וֹךְ וְקָ֙מָה֙ בְּיָ֣דְךָ֔ מַמְלֶ֖כֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh yā·ḏa‘·tî kî mā·lōḵ tim·lō·wḵ wə·qā·māh bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā mam·le·ḵeṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now I know . . . for sure that you will be king . . . and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands
verses.literalPt: Agora, sei que sem falta hás de ser rei e que o reino de Israel há de se firmar na tua mão.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּׁ֤בְעָה לִּי֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה אִם־ תַּכְרִ֥ית אֶת־ זַרְעִ֖י אַֽחֲרָ֑י וְאִם־ תַּשְׁמִ֥יד אֶת־ שְׁמִ֖י מִבֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hiš·šā·ḇə·‘āh lî Yah·weh ’im- taḵ·rîṯ ’eṯ- zar·‘î ’a·ḥă·rāy wə·’im- taš·mîḏ ’eṯ- šə·mî mib·bêṯ ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: So now swear to me by the LORD that you will not cut off my descendants . . . . . . or wipe out my name from my father’s house
verses.literalPt: Agora, jura-me por Jeová que não exterminarás a minha semente depois de mim e que não extinguirás o meu nome da casa de meu pai.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֥ע דָּוִ֖ד לְשָׁא֑וּל וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל־ בֵּית֔וֹ וְדָוִד֙ וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֔יו עָל֖וּ עַל־ הַמְּצוּדָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ dā·wiḏ lə·šā·’ūl way·yê·leḵ šā·’ūl ’el- bê·ṯōw wə·ḏā·wiḏ wa·’ă·nā·šāw ‘ā·lū ‘al- ham·mə·ṣū·ḏāh
verses.literal: So David gave his oath to Saul Then Saul . . . returned home but David and his men went up to the stronghold
verses.literalPt: Davi o jurou a Saul. Voltou Saul para sua casa, mas Davi e seus homens subiram ao lugar seguro.
